what_it_does: Bitcoin mining requires performing many repetitions of a cryptographic hash function called SHA-256. This paper designs an efficient hardware implementation of dual SHA-256 (two hash operations) on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA), which is a reconfigurable computing chip. The design maximizes the rate at which hashes can be computed per unit time, directly improving mining profitability. The researchers compare their FPGA approach against custom silicon (ASIC) designs at different manufacturing scales to understand performance tradeoffs.
